4755_canonical_24d_lattice.unimodular_embedding_no_go: For any scalar c making this Gram integral, c is an integer because an inner product 1 occurs. det(cL)=c^24 det(L) retains odd 5-adic valuation, so it cannot be the determinant-square of a full-rank sublattice of an integral unimodular lattice.
4755_canonical_24d_lattice.representation_boundary: This blocks the canonical projected residue lattice, not the abstract 24-dimensional PSp representation or another commensurable invariant lattice.

4759_cube_sum_45_frame.interpretation: The cube-sum vectors collapse through three-packets to the canonical 24-dimensional spherical embedding of the 45-point GQ quotient.

boundary: The 24-dimensional representation bridge is distinct from a Leech-lattice embedding; the latter requires an explicit invariant lattice isometry, and the most canonical residue lattice fails the unimodular determinant test.
